items.title: 18.7.2 Cobalt(II) complexes ke ligand exchange reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the ligand exchange reactions of cobalt(II) (PDF 28-29).

blocks.text: Cobalt(II) ke namak bhi paani mein complex ions banate hain: Co2+(aq) ka matlab [Co(H2O)6]2+ hai, jo cobalt(II) sulphate ke mehlool ko gulabi rang deta hai.

blocks.caption: Cobalt(II) ke ligand exchange reactions
rows: gulabi mehlool se neela precipitate, jo pare pare gulabi ho sakta hai
ghulne wala hexaamminecobalt(II) ion; peela mehlool
paani ke ligands seedhe ammonia se badalte

blocks.alt: Oopar ki qatar: gulabi [Co(H2O)6]2+ mehlool; NaOH milane se [Co(H2O)4(OH)2] ka neela precipitate, jo pare pare gulabi ho sakta hai; zaid NH3 [Co(NH3)6]2+ ka peela (bhoosa rang) mehlool deta hai. Neeche ki qatar: conc. HCl gulabi octahedral [Co(H2O)6]2+ ko neele tetrahedral [CoCl4]2- mein badalta hai; paani wapas le aata hai.
blocks.caption: Cobalt(II) complexes ke ligand exchange aur rang ki tabdeeliyan (Figures 18.9 aur 18.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Cobalt(II) ion bhi milta julta rawaiya rakhta hai. Hydroxide ions cobalt(II) hydroxide ka neela precipitate dete hain; zaid ammonia paani aur hydroxide ligands ki jagah le kar ghulne wala hexaamminecobalt(II) ion deta hai, jo peela hai. Garha hydrochloric acid neela tetrahedral tetrachlorocobaltate(II) ion deta hai. Gulabi se neele ki tabdeeli ke saath shakal aur coordination number bhi badalte hain, octahedral (6) se tetrahedral (4).

blocks.text: Paani wale cobalt(II) ions aam taur par Cl-, OH- aur SCN- jaise monodentate anionic ligands ke saath tetrahedral complexes banate hain.

blocks.prompt: Cobalt(II) mehlool mein conc. HCl milane par rang mein kya tabdeeli aati hai, aur kaun sa ion banta hai?
blocks.explanation: Gulabi se neela, kyunke tetrahedral [CoCl4]2- banta hai.

items: Zaid NH3 se peela [Co(NH3)6]2+; conc. HCl se neela [CoCl4]2-.
